entities.name: text amendment
entities.description: An amendment to the official zoning code of the City of Coral Gables, specifically creating a new section 5-314 for regulating window and hurricane shutters and amending penalties related to their closure outside of hurricane season.

entities.name: Window and Hurricane Shutters
entities.description: Regulations concerning the installation, closure, and penalties related to window and hurricane shutters in the City of Coral Gables, including provisions for their regulation outside of hurricane season.

entities.name: code enforcement issues
entities.description: Issues related to the enforcement of city codes, including penalties for violations such as improper closure of window and hurricane shutters outside of designated hurricane season periods.
